name: 88220 · Carlsbad, NM
findings: ZIP 88220 (Carlsbad) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88220 (Carlsbad) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 88220 (Carlsbad) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
